title: Chainlance
tagline: DFM is a decentralized platform that matches freelancers with clients, automates contracts, and ensures transparent payments. It offers a secure, low-cost, and efficient experience with AI-powered, blockchain-based systems.
description: The Decentralized Freelance Marketplace (DFM) is an innovative blockchain-based platform that transforms how freelancers and clients connect, collaborate, and transact. By integrating cutting-edge AI and decentralized technologies, DFM ensures trust, efficiency, and cost savings through automated contract management, escrow services, and transparent reputation tracking.
how_its_made:
DFM integrates blockchain, AI, and decentralized hosting for a trustless freelance marketplace.

🔗 Smart Contracts (EigenLayer) – Verifies contracts and tracks freelancer reputation with on-chain data.
🤖 AI Automation (AgentKit) – AI agents handle escrow, automate contract execution, and match freelancers.
🌍 Decentralized Hosting (OneSec) – Ensures uptime and global accessibility.

🚀 Notable Hack: Used EigenDA for efficient reputation storage and AI-powered proof-of-work validation before escrow release.
